subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement - FinPath
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@finpath.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo timing

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to learn more about FinPath's developer platform and the issues you're seeing around inference latency and per-token cost. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary use case is real-time summarization for customer support (median seq length ~400 tokens), looking to reduce tail latency and cost per 1k tokens.
- Success criteria: <20% reduction in median latency; predictable 95th percentile; ability to pin models for compliance.
- Next step: 60-75 minute technical demo + deep-dive with our SE to walk through architecture, KV cache options, and SLO tuning.

Can you share availability for a deep-dive next week? Here are a few slots on my side (PST):
- Tue 12/15 10:00-11:15am
- Wed 12/16 1:00-2:15pm
- Thu 12/17 11:00-12:15pm

If any of those don't work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Also — you mentioned looping in security and procurement. If you can introduce the right contacts, I’ll bring Neha (security) and our contracts lead to the thread.

Attaching a short demo agenda and high-level architecture doc so your team can scan before the call.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda.pdf (1 page)

From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.t@finpath.com>, procurement@finpath.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo timing

Thanks, Marissa — that recap looks right. The team is keen to see the technical deep-dive. Of the slots you suggested, Wed 12/16 1:00pm PST works best for myself and our platform lead (Elena).

I'll loop in our security contact and procurement so they can either join or send questions ahead of time: I'm copying procurement@finpath.com here. Please also include any pre-demo checklist your security team prefers.

Couple asks for the demo:
- Can you show how Redwood handles prefilling KV cache and warm starts?
- Any examples of autoscaling behavior under bursty traffic?

Thanks — Samir
Samir Gupta
Director of Platform Engineering, FinPath
samir.g@finpath.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.g@finpath.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.t@finpath.com>, procurement@finpath.com, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 12:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps and demo timing

Perfect — thanks for confirming Wed 12/16 1:00pm PST. I’ve tentatively booked that slot on our side; final calendar invite will go out once we lock.

Looping in Neha (security) and Dev (SE) so they can prep: Neha, Samir mentioned requirements around audit logs, data residency and KMS/HSM integration; can you share our security pre-demo checklist and any materials that map to SOC2/ISO controls? Dev — we'll plan the deep-dive to include cache warm starts, autoscaling, and a brief kernel selection/quantization discussion tailored to FinPath's seq lengths.

If procurement wants a separate short sync to cover contracting/timing, happy to schedule a 30-minute session the same week.

Thanks — I’ll send the invite and a calendar with dial-in + agenda by EOD.

Cheers,
Marissa

From: procurement@finpath.com <procurement@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:17:00 -0500

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note. Procurement here — can you please share your standard MSA/licensing overview and typical commercial terms for Dedicated vs Hosted? Also send PO/contract contacts for Redwood so we know who to engage.

If possible, attach a one-page summary of pricing bands and any minimum commitments. If you have a prefilled procurement questionnaire, that would help speed review.

Best,

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the technical deep-dive: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 at 1:00pm PST (60 minutes) — calendar invite is attached and sent; please accept when you can.

For procurement, attaching a one-pager high-level pricing bands and our standard MSA overview. Neha has attached a short security checklist (Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf) that maps to SOC2, KMS/HSM, and data residency.

Agenda (attached Redwood_Demo_Agenda.pdf):
- 0-10m: intros & goals
- 10-30m: architecture deep-dive (cache, KV, compilation choices)
- 30-50m: live demo (warm start + autoscaling under burst)
- 50-60m: next steps & procurement/contract timeline

If procurement prefers a separate 30-minute commercial sync, we can do Thu 12/17 10:00am PST. Please respond with preference.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa
